This is an internal conflict between requirements.md's own Overview/Non-goals sections and requirements.md's AC-009 plus acceptance-tests.md's TEST-009, so it is a spec-review-scoped defect (not an implementation or quality-gate concern) that must be resolved before task decomposition can proceed without guessing at which framing is authoritative -- a workflow-boundary contradiction about what phase this package is actually in, justifying Critical severity.
